properties.displayName: Entrada externa negada em porta administrativa
properties.description:
Esta consulta identifica volume de tentativas negadas, a partir de
endereços IP públicos, contra portas administrativas. O foco é
varredura ou acesso remoto indevido visto em log no formato CEF.
properties.query:
let adminPorts = dynamic([22, 135, 445, 1433, 3389, 5985, 5986]);
let attemptThreshold = 5;
CommonSecurityLog
| where DestinationPort in (adminPorts)
| where DeviceAction in~ ("deny", "denied", "drop", "dropped", "block", "blocked")
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(DestinationIP)
| where ipv4_is_private(SourceIP) == false
| summarize
    Attempts = count(),
    Ports = make_set(DestinationPort, 10),
    Actions = make_set(DeviceAction, 5),
    StartTime = min(TimeGenerated),
    EndTime = max(TimeGenerated)
    by SourceIP, DestinationIP, DeviceProduct
| where Attempts >= attemptThreshold
| extend
    AttemptsText = tostring(Attempts),
    PortsText = strcat_array(Ports, ",")
